additional_info.subject: 0411690 - ID0411690-DC/Si-D/DE [MP / R9 170002775] Charger Offline CRM:01282000862
additional_info.body:
Dear Eduard Huber - TankE GmbH,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Vaishnavy
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
: MP / R9 170002775
ChargerID/Serial No.
: VRpzYW
Problem Description
: Charger Offline
Troubleshooting
:
I’d like to begin by offering our sincerest apologies for the delay in addressing your case. We truly understand the frustration this may have caused, and we want to express our regret for any inconvenience you’ve experienced. Unfortunately, due to an unexpected glitch in our system, we had to recreate your case, which resulted in the delay.
After reviewing the logs on our backend, we found that the system is currently offline, and it seems the configuration file is corrupted. Regrettably, due to this issue, we’re unable to access the system remotely via SSH to make repairs.
As a resolution, we will need to flash the CFast card with new configurations to restore normal functionality. To carry this out, we are arranging a visit from our regional country team to assist you on-site. They will contact you directly to schedule the visit and provide the necessary support.
We truly appreciate your patience and understanding during this time, and once again, we apologize for any inconvenience caused. Please know that we are working to ensure a swift resolution.
Thank you for your continued support.
For future reference, your case number is
0411694
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vaishnavy Gurav

Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to inform you that we’ve encountered an issue with this charger, the configuration file appears to be corrupted, resulting in the system going offline. After assessment, we’ve determined that flashing the CFast card with new configurations is the necessary resolution.
Could you please let me know when you plan to schedule the site visit to carry out this task in advance if you require intervention support from our side.
Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
